title: Home Office Romance
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A single-volume story by the creator of Sweat and Soap. Nokoru starts working from home during the pandemic, finds his life better away from the office, takes up old hobbies such as decorating his balcony, and slowly gets to know his neighbor Natsu.
life_message: A slower life with room for hobbies and neighbors can open the way to love.
